data.name: Rodolphe
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old Germanic element 'hrod', meaning 'fame' and 'wolf'. The name Rodolphe was popular among the Germanic and European nobility, and was often given to rulers and warriors. In Christian tradition, Rodolphe is also associated with the biblical figure Rudolph, the Hunchback Saint.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes strength, leadership, and courage in the face of adversity.

in_hebrew.name: רודולף
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם רודולף נגזר מהמילה 'הרוד' או 'הרודיק' שפירושה 'דוד' או 'בן דוד', השם רקורן במסורת נוצרית, ואין לו מקור יהודי.

in_greek.name: Ροδόλφος
in_greek.meaning: πρόκειται για ένα γερμανικό όνομα, σημαίνει δούλος της γης
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ροδόλφος προέρχεται από την γερμανική γλώσσα και σημαίνει δούλος της γης. Στην αρχαιότητα, η λέξη 'ροδόλφος' χρησιμοποιήθηκε για να περιγράψει έναν απελεύθερο που κατέβηκε από τους γερμανούς βαρβάροι.

in_latin.name: Rodolphus
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Rodolphus ex lingua Germanica originem ducit, significat servus terrae. In antiqua Germania, locus natalis Rodolphi, nomen hoc ut erat in usu apud barbaros Germanos, servus terrae in Latinum conversus est, quo significabat libertatem, sed servitutem terrae.

in_english.name: Rodolphe
in_english.meaning: Germanic name meaning servant of the land
in_english.long_meaning: The name Rodolphe originates from the Germanic language and means servant of the land. In ancient Germany, the area of origin of Rodolphe, this name was in use among the Germanic barbarians, servant of the land in Latin, meaning freedom, but also servitude to the land.

data.cultural_impact: The name Rodolphe is highly evocative of strength, leadership, and renown. In European history, rulers like Rodolphe of Habsburg and Rodolphe of Burgundy were celebrated for their courage and military prowess. The name continues to be associated with nobility and power even in modern times.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian tradition, the name Rodolphe is also linked to the saint Rudolph, whose spiritual journey involved overcoming physical challenges and finding inner strength. This namesake inspires us to embrace our challenges and weaknesses as opportunities for growth, and to tap into our inner strength to face life's adversities.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Rodolphe as a variant of Rudolph, popular in medieval Europe The name Rodolphe carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
